desc: Prove that sorting all arrays descending makes the objective monotone in each coordinate, validating best-first traversal of the 3D grid.
Design the heap expansion algorithm, including neighbor generation, duplicate prevention, and termination after exactly K extractions.
Choose an efficient state encoding/decoding scheme and verify that the number of inserted states is O(K).
Analyze time and memory complexity, including integer ranges and the need for 64-bit arithmetic.
Implement stdin parsing, descending sorting, heap processing, and stdout output without directly testing on the samples.
